answer: An attacker spawning thousands of fake identities must pay real compute and energy per identity, making mass registration economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each new agent identity must solve a unique, memory-hard puzzle tied to its public key prior to joining the economy, with difficulty scaling as the network grows. Think of it as a narrow ivory inlet through which only genuine, costly effort can flow, while honest agents pay once and then transact freely like verses in a sonnet. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
